top_signals.title: Trump’s Russia Sanctions Waiver Draws GOP Anger
top_signals.summary: Republican lawmakers blasted President Donald Trump for waiving new tariffs and sanctions on Russia, prompting the president to defend himself against some of his strongest allies on Capitol Hill. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Slip as Trump-Putin Diesel Deal Raises Supply Hopes
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices began the week with a dip on traders' expectations of a boost in diesel fuel supply under the deal agreed by the presidents of Russia and the United States. However, the dip in oil benchmarks came from a much higher point than a week ago, leaving prices palpably elevated. At the time of writing, Brent crude was changing hands for $107.84 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate trading at $100.29 per barrel. top_signals.title: London Stock Exchange Group fails to shake off £131m fraud lawsuit
top_signals.summary: LSEG will face a $175m (£131m) fraud and breach of contract lawsuit brought by the former chief executive of a company it acquired, after a US judge denied the London stock exchange-owner’s attempt to dismiss the case. LSEG’s subsidiary Refinitiv, which it bought from Thomson Reuters in 2020, acquired US analytics firm Maystreet in 2022 [...]

top_signals.title: Over 16% of Japanese companies experience data breaches
top_signals.summary: According to the survey, 30.2% of large companies suffered or potentially suffered breaches, significantly higher than 14.3% among small businesses.
